o.text: From Russian лаборато́рия (laboratórija), from Latin laboratorium.
From Proto-Turkic *kemür- (“to gnaw”). Cognate with Turkish kemirmek.
From Ottoman Turkish مشروطه, from Arabic مَشْرُوط (mašrūṭ)
